stepTitle: Jessica designed the following loss function to optimize her logistic regression model: $$\mathcal{L}(\theta) $$=$$ -\left[y\log(p) + (1-y)\log\left((1-p)**{3}\right)\right]$$ where $$p$$ is the probability that the corresponding datapoint belongs to class $$1$$.
stepBody: Evaluate the following statements about $$\mathcal{L}$$ and cross-entropy loss.\n\nWhenever a logistic regression model classifies a datapoint into class $$0$$, the loss component $$y\log(p)$$ is equal to $$0$$.
